datasheet.title: EX2300-C Compact Ethernet Switch datasheet, document 1000580-017-JP (Juniper Networks, September 2021)

description: Juniper EX2300-C-12T is the compact, fanless, non-PoE member of the EX2300 line: a 1RU-high Gigabit Ethernet access switch 279 mm wide with 12 10/100/1000BASE-T ports and two built-in 10-Gigabit SFP+/SFP uplink ports. The front carries the 12 jacks in two stacked rows numbered 0 to 11 (the upper jack of a column takes the even number), the two uplinks numbered 0 and 1, a USB port, the management Ethernet port with the RJ-45 console port under it, a mini-USB console port, three status lamps, three port-mode lamps, a Factory Reset/Mode button and an ESD point. The rear carries the earthing terminal and the AC power cord inlet; there are no fans and no heatsink. The power supply is built into the chassis, so there are no bays. It ships standing on its rubber feet; it can also be fixed under a desk, to a wall or a ferrous surface, or on two posts of a rack with the separately orderable brackets. The -TAA and -VC part numbers are the same chassis. The EX2300-C-12P is the same front with PoE.

name: ex2300-c-12t

airflow.note: The cooling system "consists of the vents on the top of the chassis"; there are no fans, so the chassis is passive.

built-in-power-and-fans.note: Hardware guide, Power Supply in EX2300 Switches: "The power supply in EX2300 switches is built in along the rear panel of the chassis"; Table 2 lists "Switch with built-in power supply" and, for the fan, "EX2300-C switches are fanless models". Nothing in the guide describes removing or replacing the supply. It is part of the chassis, not a bay and not a component, and there are no fans.

chassis.note: Table 3: height 1.72 in (4.36 cm), width 10.98 in (27.9 cm), 18.86 in (47.9 cm) with the mounting brackets attached, depth 9.45 in (23.8 cm), weight 5.45 lb (2.48 kg). 279.0 x 43.6 x 238.0 is carried, the metric as printed. The datasheet (Table 1 and physical specifications) gives 27.9 x 4.4 x 23.9 cm (10.98 x 1.72 x 9.4 in) and 1 RU; the guide's depth is used, 1 mm shallower, because the guide's own metric and inch figures disagree (9.45 in is 240 mm) and the printed metric is the one the other EX2300 devices carry.

colour.note: median of the bare front plate in the photograph (#686d71).

esd-point.note: photo-measured - Figure 2 callout 10: the ESD point is a banana jack on the left of the face with the ESD triangle beside it, drawn as a stroked triangle mark. A second, smaller hole under it in the photograph carries no printing and is not named by the guide, so it is not drawn.

front-console.note: estimated - the mini-USB console port (guide Figure 2, callout 7) is drawn as chassis art, a 7.9 x 4.6 mm shell with its opening. It is not a component: the library has no mini-USB receptacle and its DCIM export has no row for one.

front-layout.note: estimated - read off the front photograph as described under gate-1. The same arrangement as the EX2300-C-12P: one shell of six jack columns, the first jack at 38.1 mm, 13.97 apart, the rows 14.1 mm apart with the upper row turned 180; two SFP+ cages 33.9 mm apart with LINK over ST on their left; an upright USB-A port; the stacked management and console housing with the management jack on top turned 180; the mini-USB console port as chassis art; the two ribbed end caps. The photograph shows two small corner marks beside the uplinks and above the USB port that carry no printing and are not drawn. The mode glyph is printed on the button's cap; the library's button has none, so the glyph stands beside it as on the other EX2300 devices.

gate-1.note: The front photograph is 1500 x 300 px with the body (bumper to bumper) 1449 px across: 5.194 px per mm against the 279 mm of Table 3, and the jack pitch reads 72.8 px = 14.02 mm against the registry's 13.97. The photograph is 6.14 across to down (bumpers included, 1449 by 236 px) against the table's 279 / 43.6 = 6.40, so y is taken at the same px per mm with the body centred on the bumper extent; the guide's Figure 2 shows the same aspect, so neither passes the aspect check and Figure 2 is used for what is on the face, not for absolute y. The 12T's face is the 12P's to within a millimetre in every feature both photographs show (the first jack reads 38.1 mm here against 38.4 there), so the positions other than the jack block are shared. Every position is therefore estimated and good to about a millimetre.

lamps.note: Hardware guide, Tables 4 to 12 and Figures 16, 20, 24, 25 and 27. Each RJ-45 port and uplink has two lamps, Link/Activity and Status; the Status lamp reads out whichever of SPD, DX and EN the Factory Reset/Mode button has selected, shown by which port-mode lamp is lit. The guide's Figure 2 and callout 5 give three port-mode lamps on a model without PoE ("The LED labeled PoE is present only on models with PoE capability"). The photograph prints a PoE legend at the fourth place all the same, in grey and with no lamp, so the legend is drawn and no lamp is placed: the photograph of the real unit wins on what is printed, the guide on what is lit. SYS is green, ALM red or yellow and MST green. The jack lamps keep the component's link and activity vocabulary because a block cannot override it per lamp.

mounting.note: Table 35 and Table 34: the switch ships standing on four preinstalled rubber feet; it mounts on or under a desk or level surface, on a wall by screws, on or under a ferrous surface with the separately orderable magnet-mount kit, and on two posts of a 19 in rack or cabinet (also a four-post one) with mounting brackets and screws that are "separately orderable for EX2300-C switches"; it cannot be mounted recessed. The guide gives no part number for the EX2300-C bracket kit, the wall screws, the magnet-mount kit, the cable guard kit or the cable lock kit, so none is listed and no ear position is stated; the datasheet states a height of 1 RU, so the chassis is a rack device of 1 RU and a viewer that asks for ears gets the generic pair.

port-numbering.note: photo-measured - the photograph prints each column's two numbers in grey under the shell (orange on the PoE model), the even number up and left and the odd number down and right (0 and 1, ... 10 and 11), so the upper jack takes the even number; the two uplinks print 0 and 1 under their cages. Port numbers are as printed on the metal, from 0. The Junos interface names are not printed: the guide's Table 2 gives PIC 0 as 12x10/100/1000 Base-T and PIC 1 as 2x10G SFP/SFP+, i.e. ge-0/0/0 to ge-0/0/11 and xe-0/1/0 and xe-0/1/1; they are recorded here and not in an interfaces block because the faceplate does not print them.

power.note: Table 14: maximum power consumed by the switch 20 W, no PoE; Table 15: 100 through 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, 1 A at 100 VAC and 0.5 A at 240 VAC. The datasheet's power rating (40 W AC) is recorded and not carried.

rear-layout.note: estimated - positions off the guide's Figure 8 (1500 x 327 px, body 1342 px across at 4.81 px per mm) for the AC inlet and the two screws, and off the EX2300-C-12P rear photograph for the earthing holes and symbol, which Figure 8 draws in the same place. The inlet sits 21 mm nearer the middle than on the 12P because there is no heatsink beside it. The guide's drawn serial number and CLEI rectangles (callouts 1 and 2) are left out: they are paper labels carrying real serial numbers. No studio photograph of this rear is held.

rear-legend.note: Figure 8 prints "AC INPUT : 100-240V~ 50-60Hz : 2.5A Max" beside the inlet. Table 15 gives the EX2300-C-12T 1 A at 100 VAC and 0.5 A at 240 VAC, so the legend and the table disagree (2.5 A is the 12P's figure in Table 15); the legend is drawn as the figure prints it, the table's figure is carried in attrs, and the conflict is recorded rather than settled.

sources.note: EX2300 Switch Hardware Guide, Juniper Networks, published 2025-08-12 (314 pages; https://www.juniper.net/documentation/us/en/hardware/ex2300/ex2300.pdf): Figure 2 (front panel), Figure 8 (rear panel), Table 1 (models), Table 3 (chassis size and weight), Tables 4 to 12 (LEDs and Figures 16, 20, 24, 25, 27), the cooling system section, Tables 14 and 15 (power), Table 34 (parts list) and Table 35 (mounting methods). The EX2300-C Compact Ethernet Switch datasheet, Juniper Networks, document 1000580-017-JP, September 2021 (the Japanese edition, https://www.juniper.net/content/dam/www/assets/datasheets/jp/ja/switches/ex2300-c-compact-ethernet-switch-datasheet.pdf): its Table 1 and physical specifications. Juniper's own straight-on studio photograph of the EX2300-C-12T front (ex2300-12t-front-high.jpg) from the maker's image library (https://www.juniper.net/us/en/company/images/image-library-logos-and-product-photos/products/ex2300-12t.html), which holds no rear photograph of this model: its rear is drawn from the guide's Figure 8, with the earthing holes and the end caps taken from the EX2300-C-12P rear photograph (ex2300-12p-rear-high.jpg) because Figure 8 draws them the same. The English datasheet address tried (ex2300-ethernet-switch-datasheet.pdf under the same datasheets/us/en/switches path) did not answer, so no English datasheet is cited.
